audit.why: Lane difficulty reads TRICKY 7/10 against a 54.67% Emerald+ win rate over 2036 games; the prose already frames Darius as the lane winner until Ryze scales, so the tone is defensible but the level chart contradicted it.
audit.corrected: Kept diff/diffRating; corrected the chart so every stage before 2+ items reads Darius.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].side and phases[4].side said Skill, phases[6].side said Darius, while win[2]/win[4] said Skill and win[6] said Darius — but the whys, the breakdown prose and the packet chart all say Darius wins Levels 3 and 6 and Ryze wins 2+ items.
audit.why: The chart contradicted its own explanatory text and the packet.
audit.corrected: Levels 3 and 6 flipped to Darius; 2+ items flipped to Ryze, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text called Rune Prison an 'E root'. Ryze's E is Spell Flux; W is Rune Prison. More importantly the decisive interaction was never stated: Rune Prison only ROOTS a target that already carries Flux — without it, W is a slow.
audit.why: Riot's own text: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.'
audit.corrected: Named the abilities correctly and stated the Flux gate, with Rune Prison's 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried scraped junk ('Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 63') and no numbers.
audit.why: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Rune Prison's real cooldown and the sequencing rule.

edits.before: Your spike: Ryze's Q poke and E root are dangerous but he's squishy and immobile — E him in, Q on the edge and stack Hemorrhage; he can't kite a full combo without Flash.
edits.after: Your spike: Rune Prison (W) only roots you if Spell Flux (E) landed first, so dodge the orb and W is a slow — Apprehend in, Q on the outer blade, stack Hemorrhage; he cannot kite that.

edits.before: Your spike continues — your R execute threat is enormous on a low-HP mage. Even through his W root, 5 stacks plus Noxian Guillotine deletes him before he can Q-chain you down.
edits.after: Your spike continues — Noxian Guillotine is true damage, so his mana-shield scaling means nothing. Rune Prison is 10s at rank 3: eat the root, and 5 stacks plus the execute still kill him.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux — the orb is the tell. Spent, it is 9-11s before he holds you.

notes: Ryze's root is W (Rune Prison), not E (Spell Flux); the site text had this backwards in one place. Rune Prison roots only if Flux is already applied, otherwise it slows — this is the decisive interaction for a Darius all-in and was absent everywhere. Level chart contradicted both the packet and its own whys at Levels 3, 6 and 2+ items.
